items.title: Update your holiday hours on Google
items.why: Customers check your hours before they drive over. Wrong hours cost visits.

items.title: Send one holiday email to past customers
items.why: A short thank-you with a simple offer brings people back.

items.title: Pin your gift card or best offer
items.why: Put it at the top of your website and social profiles.

items.title: Ask December customers for a review
items.why: Fresh reviews carry you into January.
